Naoya
“All I can tell you is that she isn't remotely like yesterday's mob. She isn't like Kawachino or Hikawa; probably not like Kei, Toritani, or Akashi either. And she certainly isn't like me.”

“No, that was idle talk. Forget it. Just think it through before you decide anything about Rin Misakura. That's all I can tell you.”
